basics.name: Henri Mäkinen
basics.label: Senior Software Developer and Partner
basics.summary:
Henri Mäkinen is a software developer with vast experience in various IT positions. His experience includes a wide range of business domains from publishing, retail, telecom, fintech and industry to government fields, covering several projects with different tasks in designing, creating, and maintaining software solutions.

These days, he's focused on web technologies, with an emphasis on back-end development. His core strength is Java but he's capable of acting as a full-stack developer. He believes strongly in test-driven development practices, and that it is the team-work that makes projects shine. He gets his motivation from delivering high-quality solutions meeting the business needs.

He's using AI mainly as an assistant in software development.
basics.x-tagline: Great developers turn hard problems into something anyone can follow, by writing clean and well-crafted code.

x-strengths.title: Backend development, Java ecosystem
x-strengths.description: Henri has 18 years of experience in Java development and architectural design.

x-strengths.title: Quality focused
x-strengths.description: Believes in quality driven development by developing practices and processes.

x-keyRoles.title: Lead developer
x-keyRoles.description: As a lead developer, Henri has overseen whole projects from technology selection to implementation and documentation.

x-keyRoles.title: Senior backend developer
x-keyRoles.description: Henri has experience with multiple projects in the role of senior backend developer, with responsibilities including e.g. architectural design, development and team leading.

x-keySkills.title: Generative AI and Coding Tools
x-keySkills.description: Familiar with AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT. Experienced in generating test cases using Copilot and leveraging Claude for creative, home-based coding projects.

projects.name: Digital learning content service
projects.x-note: Role is 'Backend developer' in the project list and 'Senior Backend Developer' on the highlight slide.
projects.description: Back-end developer of digital content for pupils in elementary and secondary schools. The service is a tool for publishers who can create content and assignments for students as well as an interface for pupils and students. Being part of making design and architectural decisions for the software since the project started from scratch. The project included a MongoDB assessment. Later on one of five back-end developers in the team focusing on database and Java development. Reviewing React FE code.

projects.name: Research application development and competence transfer
projects.description:
Working with an online application service as a software developer and in consultant roles for the institute's digital services group.

Internal Java/Spring Boot application for the institute's researchers. Implementing extensions and improvements for functionalities of the application, e.g. a womb operation process.

Java-based BE application for transferring data between the institute and a natural history museum. Integration is done via REST API, and Henri extended the old code base by setting up one import data collection and 4 different data sets for export to the museum.

More of a consultant role for competence transfer, helping a developer tasked to take over the Java-based BE application.

projects.name: Patient engagement application
projects.description: Back-end developer of the Patient engagement team of a patient engagement app. One of the main tasks was to participate in the very first micro-service of the team, implemented with Spring Boot and Kotlin. REST APIs were defined with OpenAPI, as the development environment is a highly regulated medical field.

projects.name: Research data services and applications
projects.x-note: The project list gives 2019-2021 (2 years, 8 months), the highlight slide 2019-2022; the project list dates are used.
projects.description:
Software developer as a member of the digital services group. Self-directed developer with experience delivering end-to-end solo projects. In addition to common developer duties, Henri participated in improving CI processes, e.g. setting up a Jenkins CI application.

Java Spring Boot & Angular project to present scientific research results regarding the fish density of a river in northern Finland. Results are built over OpenStreetMap using the OpenLayers library. One of the challenging issues was the integration of the Angular FE to be part of the legacy Java (war) project.

Internal Java/Spring Boot application for the institute's researchers. One of the biggest challenges was to implement a SAML2.0 based integration with a federated authentication service. The most enjoyable tasks were implementing a number of integrations with collar tracking services to track wolves, wild boars etc.

Pure BE application implemented with Java and Spring Boot to handle integration between the institute and a natural history museum. Integration was done with REST API/JSON, and the application is controlled with schedulers or web REST calls. The biggest challenge was to optimize and handle massive data streams.

Implementing, designing, and planning the architecture of the renewal project of a wildlife observation service. Henri focused on the BE application done with Java Spring Boot with multiple DB connections, with minor technical tasks to help FE development (Svelte) in a Full Stack role.

projects.name: Micro-service prototype and consulting
projects.description: Working as a software developer. Duties included continuing to work for a consumer lending fintech company as a consultant. Designing and implementing a micro-service prototype of a street light controller for one of the biggest cities of Finland in an Azure environment. The project was won through an industry hackathon.

projects.name: Digital lending back-end and integrations
projects.description:
Software developer as a member of an international developer team for a Fintech company.

Implementing a scalable and modern back-end for a digital business built on the AWS cloud environment.

Developing Java tools to generate a textual, written version of numbers for various reports, e.g. numbers in the Spanish language.

Taking over the role of lead developer of a team of 4 developers implementing, deploying and maintaining business critical core software, a so-called legacy business application running in Lithuania and Australia.

Implementing many different business integrations with various APIs needed to run digital business applications, e.g. a web service connection to Australia's biggest credit reference service.

projects.name: Teaching and studying portal
projects.description: Java/Liferay portal application for processing of teaching and studying at one of the Finnish technical universities.

projects.name: Vehicle tracking application
projects.description: Henri was implementing a vehicle tracking application as a member of the developer team. He focused on calculating different reports of vehicle routings with the Oracle spatial tools. He also set up basic CI environments and improved developer testing processes.

projects.name: Application logging on an early cloud environment
projects.description: NodeJS project on the company's early cloud environment for collecting logging data of applications based on the so-called ELK (elasticsearch/kibana) stack architecture.

projects.name: Portal and Java application development
projects.description:
Responsible for designing, implementing, and testing in the application development process as well as some solution architecture tasks. Part of everyday life was CI/unit testing and implementing Selenium/Robot FW testing tasks.

Java/Oracle portal-based intranet website for a big Finnish retail company.

Java/Spring application for handling logistics for a heavy industry corporation.

Java/Spring application for handling a welding process.

projects.name: Environmental research results application
projects.description: Software developer as a member of a Java software developer team. Java/Spring-based application for handling scientific results of research on environmental modifications.

projects.name: Smartphone application development
projects.description: Symbian & Qt application developer as a member of the application team of a smartphone platform. Besides basic programmer duties, Henri acted as a technical consultant for the UI/UX team and contributed actively to quality improvement in the development phase.

projects.name: Telecom software development
projects.description: Tasks included software designing, implementation and testing with Java. Also, some integration duties between different platforms and solutions. Projects have been in the field of telecommunication, e.g. a chat application.

projects.name: Progress DB solutions
projects.description: Duties included designing, implementing, and testing Progress DB solutions for a Swedish teleoperator.
